2645-2872-3430-5928.easyPrerequisites: Clever Conjurer doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-2872-3430-5928.description:
Activate Balduvian Trading Post by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping Balduvian Trading Post
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

643-5147-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
643-5147-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.

3240-5632-6462-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Chalk Outline triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to the creature with changeling

4640-5231-8032--201.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature with changeling, adding {R}.
When that creature dies, Oathkeeper triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When that creature enters, Swordsman triggers, allowing you to attach Oathkeeper to that creature.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

855-2122-7811.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Iron Man triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Corpsejack Menace
Repeat.

997-1619-4605-5542-6143.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
997-1619-4605-5542-6143.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Feywild Caretaker from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Feywild Caretaker enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Feywild Caretaker.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Feywild Caretaker that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Feywild Caretaker token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Feywild Caretaker token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Feywild Caretaker that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Feywild Caretaker trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
997-1619-4605-5542-6143.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

3240-3967-5477-6462.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Insidious Roots triggers, creating a Treasure token, a 1/1 Plant creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3033-6798-6972.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Vengeful Vampire
When Vengeful Vampire dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Vengeful Vampire
When Vengeful Vampire dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Umbral Collar Zealot abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
3033-6798-6972.notes: If Vengeful Vampire starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2155-3259-3480.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature with the greatest power among creatures on the battlefield.
2155-3259-3480.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2155-3259-3480.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Éomer of the Riddermark as attackers.
Éomer of the Riddermark triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

7-1824-4549.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed, or are venturing in, Tomb of Annihilation.
7-1824-4549.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-1824-4549.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
When Acererak enters, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Acererak, adding {B}.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

2034-5003-7133.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Doctor Doom, adding {C}{C}.
When Doctor Doom dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Doctor Doom from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Doctor Doom enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

512-3053-4241.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two basic land types among lands you control
512-3053-4241.description:
Activate Karn twice by paying {2}, causing Halo Fountain and Prismatic Geoscope to become a creature.
Activate Prismatic Geoscope by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}.
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and then untapping it and Prismatic Geoscope, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
512-3053-4241.notes: With the excess mana, you can use it on Halo Fountain's first ability, tapping and untapping it to create creature tokens.

104-261-3490-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-261-3490-4050.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

3330-3490-4017-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3330-3490-4017-4659.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5007-5147-6972.description:
If Morselhoarder has any -1/-1 counters on it, activate it by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 1 as necessary until Morselhoarder has no -1/-1 counters on it.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Morselhoarder.
When Morselhoarder dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

745-2232-6749.easyPrerequisites: You control six or more lands.
745-2232-6749.description:
Cast Mirrorhall Mimic by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
When Mirrorhall Mimic enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Anticausal Vestige from the battlefield to your hand.
When Anticausal Vestige leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and and put Anticausal Vestige from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Anticausal Vestige enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Mirrorhall Mimic from the battlefield to your hand.
When Mirrorhall Mimic leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Mirrorhall Mimic from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
Repeat from step 2.

2558-2829-6291-6757.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, Weapons Manufacturing triggers.
Holding priority, activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Thopter.
Repeat from step 2.
2558-2829-6291-6757.notes: You can sacrifice the Munitions tokens to Arcbound Ravager to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

2457-4094-5794-6753.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2457-4289-5295.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating three 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

4798-5632-5636.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
4798-5632-5636.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Chalk Outline triggers. Holding priority, activate Psychic Frog by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a 2/2 Detective creature token and a Clue token.
Repeat from step 2.

1069-2079-3552-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-2079-3552-5499.description:
Activate Blaring Recruiter by paying {2}{W}, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Warrior.
Activate the Warrior by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

2092-3122-3719-5326.notablePrerequisites: Undercover Operative and Agatha of the Vile Cauldron each have a power of at least 2.
2092-3122-3719-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Undercover Operative and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Undercover Operative from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Undercover Operative to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Undercover Operative enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Undercover Operative by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

2178-2921-5969-5970.notablePrerequisites:
Marina does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Marina.
Spiked Corridor is locked.
2178-2921-5969-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocked Spiked Corridor.
Spiked Corridor triggers, creating three 1/1 Devil creature tokens.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a Devil.
When the Devil dies, it and Marina trigger.
Resolve the Devil's trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Marina trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Spiked Corridor.
Repeat steps 3 through 7 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

3129-3389-4050-5043.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}, targeting any creature you control.
Alela triggers, creating two 1/1 Faerie creature tokens with flying.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Faerie tokens, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia

1298-2232-4113.notablePrerequisites:
Sea Tyrant of Segovia.
You have a noncreature, nonartifact permanent card in hand that can be cast using only red mana.
You control a nontoken, noncreature, nonartifact permanent that shares a card type with the card in your hand, and that can be cast using only red mana.
You are able to cast the card in hand.
If the card on the battlefield has a larger mana value than the card in hand, you either have enough mana or control enough creatures to pay for the difference.
1298-2232-4113.description:
Cast the card from your hand by paying its mana cost reduced by the number of other creatures you tap as you cast it.
Ovika triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Phyrexian Goblin creature tokens with haste equal to that spell's mana value.
When the Phyrexian Goblins enter the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers that many times.
Resolve all Cloudstone Curio triggers, choosing not to return anything to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the permanent spell cast in step 1.
When the permanent enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning another nontoken, noncreature, nonartifact permanent that shares a type with the permanent that entered the battlefield to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

67-2281-2438.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Reveillark.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Reveillark trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1365-4050-4404-4751.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Verdurous Gearhulk and Corridor Monitor persist until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Corridor Monitor, adding one mana of any color.
Corridor Monitor dies, triggering its persist ability, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Verdurous Gearhulk, adding one mana of any color.
Verdurous Gearhulk dies, triggering its persist ability, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Verdurous Gearhulk enters the battlefield, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and Corridor Monitor, and two +1/+1 counters on any other creature(s) you control.
Repeat.

1357-1980-4821.notablePrerequisites: Nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1357-1980-4821.description:
Activate all mana producing nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Dramatic Reversal by paying {1}{U}.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, creating a copy of Dramatic Reversal.
Activate Errant by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Dramatic Reversal copy.
Resolve the first Dramatic Reversal copy, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
Activate all mana producing nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Repeat from step 4.

770-3519-4115.notablePrerequisites: You do not control another Jellyfish or have a Jellyfish in your graveyard.
770-3519-4115.description:
Cast Man-o'-War by paying {2}{U}.
Volo triggers, creating a copy of the Man-o'-War spell.
The Man-o'-War copy enters, triggering itself.
Holding priority, activate Food Chain by exiling the Man-o'-War token, adding {U}{U}{U}{U} that can only be spent on creature spells.
Man-o'-War enters the battlefield, returning itself to your hand.
Repeat.

1636-2952-3590.notablePrerequisites:
Sorcerer's Wand attached to Warchanter Skald.
Warchanter Skald does not have summoning sickness.
1636-2952-3590.description:
Activate Warchanter Skald using the Sorcerer's Wand ability by tapping it, targeting any player or planeswalker.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a 2/1 Dwarf Berserker token.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
